intent: 制作一个配药连击练习：展示“处方需要阿莫西林”的题面和三种可点击药品。选中阿莫西林时显示“配药正确”的反馈，连击数加 1 并更新计数；选错其他药品时显示“配药错误，请重新选择”的反馈且不增加连击。连击恰好达到 3 时，将 combo_celebrated 标记为 true，显示庆祝文案，并让庆祝文案使用引擎内置弹跳入场动画。
dsl:
VAR combo = 0
VAR combo_celebrated = false
TEXT combo_text "连击：{combo}" x=20 y=20 z=10
TEXT medicine_question "处方需要阿莫西林，请选择正确药品" x=180 y=100 z=10
TEXT feedback "　" x=250 y=210 z=10
TEXT correct_medicine "阿莫西林" z=10 x=180 y=150
TEXT wrong_medicine_a "布洛芬" z=10 x=320 y=150
TEXT wrong_medicine_b "维生素C" z=10 x=440 y=150
CLICK correct_medicine enabled=true block=false
    VAR combo + 1
    TEXT_SET combo_text "连击：{combo}"
    TEXT_SET feedback "配药正确！连击 +1"
    IF combo == 3
        VAR combo_celebrated = true
        TEXT celebration "三连击！配药正确！" x=250 y=270 z=20 block=true dismiss=true
        ANIM_IN celebration bounce ms=400
CLICK wrong_medicine_a enabled=true block=false
    TEXT_SET feedback "配药错误，请重新选择。"
CLICK wrong_medicine_b enabled=true block=false
    TEXT_SET feedback "配药错误，请重新选择。"
